meta_description: 3,741 likes, 164 comments - athleanx on September 9, 2026: "I see the function but I don’t prefer the form. Separated out into their individual parts (pull-ups and dips) I have no issues at all. But transition from one to the other seamlessly on a muscle up and my alarm bells go off as my shoulder screams “uncle”. Now some calisthenics masters have learned to minimize this effect at the shoulder by being able to use their lats to “lever” their body and take away some of the IR. But that requires a level of strength that many who attempt the movement just haven’t spent the time building up. For me, I’d do the components but skip the all-in-one version! #muscles #muscleups #calisthenics #trainsmart #athleanx".
